records.title: 10-K
records.text: We ended 2021 with a strong backlog of orders, which continued to grow during 2022, but at a slower pace than we experienced during the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The backlog of orders as of December 31, 2022 was $912.7 million compared to $762.6 million as of December 31, 2021, an increase of $150.1 million or 19.7%.

records.text: The acquisition was completed on April 1, 2022 at a purchase price of $19.3 million, which was paid in cash.
